_readme: Hand-maintained inputs for the IPO dashboard. Everything under data/auto/ is fetched by scripts/fetch_data.py;
everything here is judgement or slow-moving reference data. Edit, commit, and the workflow rebuilds the page.
See SETUP.md section 'Routine maintenance' for what to change and when.

ritter._columns: year, t3b_nyse, t3b_nasdaq, t1_count, t1_proceeds_bn, t1a_mktcap_bn, sp500_year_end_tn
ritter._notes: t3b = Table 3b NYSE/Nasdaq counts (US issuers, offer >= $5, main boards). t1 = Table 1 count and proceeds. t1a = Table 1a aggregate market value at first-day close. sp500_year_end_tn = approximate S&P 500 total market cap at year end. Add a row when Ritter publishes a new year; the dashboard then treats that year as historical.

seasonal._comment: Quarterly shares used to split Ritter annual totals for years without Nasdaq calendar coverage.

allocation._comment: From this year on, Ritter annual totals are split across quarters using the actual quarterly shape of the filtered Nasdaq calendar instead of seasonal weights.

calendar._comment: Nasdaq IPO calendar (api.nasdaq.com). Past months are cached once; the most recent months are re-fetched every run.

calendar_filter._comment: Proxy for Ritter Table 3b: NYSE + Nasdaq Global/Global Select only, offer >= $5, no SPACs, units, funds, trusts or REITs.

exclude_tickers.name: SK hynix
exclude_tickers.reason: US cross-listing of an already-listed Korean issuer (ADR), Jul 2026; outside Ritter's operating-company IPO universe

calibration._comment: Calendar -> Ritter mapping, pooled over every year that has both a Ritter row and 12 months of calendar data (from first_year on). Set an override to pin a value.

sp500._comment: From spy_from onward, S&P 500 total market cap = SPY close x (anchor cap / SPY close on anchor date). Earlier years use the Ritter-table year-end values. Re-anchor once a year with a published S&P 500 market cap.

anchor.source: Seeking Alpha S&P 500 market cap snapshot, fall 2026

mega_ipos.name: SpaceX
mega_ipos.detail: Priced $135 on 11 Jun 2026; first-day close $160.95 (+19%); ~13.1B shares -> ~$2.11T. $75B raised ($85.7B incl. greenshoe).

mega_ipos.name: Anthropic
mega_ipos.detail: Public S-1 filed 26 Oct 2026 (proposed Nasdaq: ANT); marketing reportedly from the week of 9 Nov; ~$75B raise expected; $1.5-2.0T listing range reported.

mega_ipos.name: OpenAI
mega_ipos.detail: Confidential S-1 filed 8 Jun 2026; listing expected early 2027 (CFO: 'public company in 2027'); pre-IPO round reportedly targeting ~$1.25T. Q2 2027 is the central timing assumption.

mega_ipos.name: Databricks
mega_ipos.detail: Raising privately at up to $175B; CEO called 2026 'a terrible year to go public'. No IPO assumed in the window.

forecast._comment: Base case (excl. mega-IPOs) in Ritter-equivalent units. The window always covers the current quarter plus the next three; quarters not listed fall back to 'default'. The current quarter blends quarter-to-date actuals with the forecast for the days remaining.

default.note: Default base case: near the 2024-26 quarterly run-rate.

quarters.note: Subdued tape: Fed hikes, 19-year-high Treasury yields, late-Q3 postponements (Oura, Holtec, Bamboo).

actual_overrides._comment: Optional per-quarter replacement of calendar-derived actuals, e.g. {"Q1 2026": {"count": 14, "nyse": 5, "mktcap_bn": 60}}. Leave empty normally.
